translationRepairs: On yichou day, in accordance with the testamentary edict, the late emperor's younger half-brother Zhimu was called before the Zaitu Hall and restored as Prince of Ning.
On yichou day, in accordance with the testamentary edict, the late emperor's elder half-brother Zhimu was called before the Zaitu Hall and restored as Prince of Ning.
s0008 has 先帝庶兄質睦; 庶兄 is elder half-brother (兄), so younger half-brother is wrong and the proposed elder half-brother matches the Chinese.
On jiawu day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Derang reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had raided the frontier; troops were dispatched and routed them.
On jiashen day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had raided the frontier; troops were dispatched and routed them.
s0021 opens with 甲申 and names 韓德威; jiawu and Han Derang (韓德讓) misread the day-cycle and personal name, and the proposed jiashen / Han Dewei are correct.
On jiawu day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Derang reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had invaded the border; troops were sent and defeated them.
On jiashen day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had invaded the border; troops were sent and defeated them.
The literal field has the same errors: 甲申 is jiashen and 韓德威 is Han Dewei, not jiawu / Han Derang.

The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains including the son of yilijin Zuiyin were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to test their sincerity and maintain strict border defenses.

The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains had seized the yilijin's son Weiyin and others and were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to test their sincerity and maintain strict border defenses.
s0071 reads 党項酋長執夷離堇子隈引等乞內附; 執 is the verb seize and 隈引 is the personal name Weiyin, so inventing a name Zuiyin from 執…引 is wrong.

On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was estranged from the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was sent out as Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was estranged from the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was sent out as Xingguo Army military commissioner.
s0073 appoints Lu Jun 興國軍節度使; 興國軍 is Xingguo Army, not Liaoxing Army.

On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was at odds with the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was then sent out as Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was at odds with the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was then sent out as Xingguo Army military commissioner.
The literal likewise misrenders 興國軍 as Liaoxing; Xingguo Army matches the Chinese.
On bingzi day Han Derang sent xiangwen zhamas to defeat the Tangut and reported the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
On bingzi day Han Dewei sent xiangwen zhamas to defeat the Tangut and reported the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
s0084 names 韓德威; Han Derang confuses him with 韓德讓, and Han Dewei is the correct rendering.
On bingzi day Han Derang sent xiangwen zhamas to break the Tangut and sent the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
On bingzi day Han Dewei sent xiangwen zhamas to break the Tangut and sent the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
Literal s0084 likewise has 韓德威, so Han Dewei is required and Han Derang is wrong.
On renzi day Han Derang memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; the court approved;
On renzi day Han Dewei memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; the court approved;
s0094 has 韓德威表請伐党項; the memorialist is Han Dewei, not Han Derang.
On renzi day Han Derang memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; an edict approved it;
On renzi day Han Dewei memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; an edict approved it;
The literal field repeats the same misnaming of 韓德威 as Han Derang; Han Dewei is correct.

On maoyin day in the third month the Huali division petitioned that xiangwen posts should henceforth be filled only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "Officials among the tribes must be chosen for ability — how can appointments be fixed by tribal limits alone."

On yimao day in the third month the Huali division petitioned that xiangwen posts should henceforth be filled only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "Officials among the tribes must be chosen for ability — how can appointments be fixed by tribal limits alone."
s0138 dates the event 三月乙卯; 乙卯 is yimao, not maoyin.

In the third month, on maoyin day, the Huali division requested that henceforth xiangwen posts be appointed only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "For officials among the divisions, what matters is getting the right men — how can appointment be fixed by division alone."

In the third month, on yimao day, the Huali division requested that henceforth xiangwen posts be appointed only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "For officials among the divisions, what matters is getting the right men — how can appointment be fixed by division alone."
Literal likewise must read 乙卯 as yimao rather than maoyin.
On maoyin day in the fifth month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
On yimao day in the fifth month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
s0145 has 五月乙卯; 乙卯 is yimao, so maoyin is a day-cycle error.
In the fifth month, on maoyin day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
In the fifth month, on yimao day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
The literal date 乙卯 must be yimao, not maoyin.

On xinchou day in the twelfth month Hanlin academician director Ma Dechen was appointed Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yao promoted to Great Inner tithen, and Darenjing Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.

On xinchou day in the twelfth month Hanlin academician director Ma Dechen was appointed Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yaosheng Great Inner tihu, and Darenjing Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
s0155 lists 耶律瑤升大內惕隱 in a parallel appointment series; 瑤升 is the given name Yaosheng and 惕隱 is tihu, not Yelü Yao promoted to tithen.

In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, Hanlin Academician Director Ma Dechen was made Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode was made Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yao was promoted to Great Inner tithen, and Darenjing was made Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.

In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, Hanlin Academician Director Ma Dechen was made Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode was made Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yaosheng was made Great Inner tihu, and Darenjing was made Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
Literal likewise splits 耶律瑤升 and misreads 升 as promoted; the name is Yelü Yaosheng and the office is Great Inner tihu.
On wuyin day Princess Hugudian was granted gold, silk, artisans, and other goods for her husband's burial.
On wuyin day Princess Hugudian was granted gold, silk, and artisans for her husband's burial.
s0200 grants only 金帛、工匠 for the burial; and other goods is not in the Chinese.
On wuyin day, Princess Hugudian was granted gold and silk, artisans, and other goods for her husband's burial.
On wuyin day, Princess Hugudian was granted gold and silk and artisans for her husband's burial.
Literal invents the same and other goods category beyond 金帛、工匠; removing it restores the source list.
On dingchou day an edict ordered Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor Qipodili to reassure the border population.
On dingchou day an edict ordered Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor, to reassure the border population.
s0199 has 東北路兵馬監軍妻婆底裏; 妻 is the kinship term wife before the name 婆底裏, not a syllable of a fused name Qipodili who holds the supervisorship.
On dingchou day, an edict ordered Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor Qipodili to comfort the border people.
On dingchou day, an edict ordered Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor, to comfort the border people.
Literal must likewise parse 監軍妻婆底裏 as Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor.
